title: Petcube App vs Dutch: Which Online Vet App Is Better for Pet Parents?
summary: A vet compares the Petcube App and Dutch: features, vet access, prescriptions, pricing, and reviews, so you can pick the right online vet app.

The[Petcube App](https://petcube.com/mobile-app/?ref=petcube.com) is a free iOS and Android app that works as a standalone pet health tracker or together with the brand’s smart pet devices (the[Petcube camera](https://petcube.com/cam/?ref=petcube.com) ), the[Emergency Fund](https://petcube.com/emergency-fund/?ref=petcube.com) , and the Online Vet.


In this article, I, Ivana Crnec, DVM, will compare the Petcube App with a popular competitor, Dutch.


**Content:**


1. What Is the App? How It Works
2. What Can You Get in the App? Vet Access, Appointments & Prescriptions
3. Free vs Paid: What Does an Online Vet Cost?
4. Is It Legit? Reviews & Real Pet Parent Feedback
5. Conclusion


## What Is the App? How It Works


In the veterinary industry, “mobile apps offer significant value,”[studies](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/393622565_Mobile_Apps_in_Veterinary_Medicine_Literature_Review_on_Opportunities_and_Benefits_for_Veterinarians_Animal_Owners_and_Animal_Welfare?ref=petcube.com) suggest. Finding the right app or[telehealth service](https://petcube.com/blog/what-to-expect-from-an-online-vet-visit/) can be challenging, since there are so many options available.


### Petcube App


The Petcube App is a mobile application available for iOS and Android. It can be used as a standalone pet care app or paired with Petcube smart hardware.


### Dutch


Dutch is a reliable veterinary telehealth service specializing in virtual vet visits and prescription treatments.


## What Can You Get in the App? Vet Access, Appointments & Prescriptions


[Studies](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35548044/?ref=petcube.com) say that “cost and transportation are two commonly cited barriers to accessing health care.” Apps help overcome these barriers, offering everything from 24/7 vet access to appointments and prescriptions.


### Petcube App


The Petcube App offers pet health tracking, AI and veterinary guidance, and[remote pet camera controls](https://petcube.com/cam-360/?ref=petcube.com) . Through the app, you can get real-time chat, video and photo sharing,[symptom checks](https://petcube.com/blog/vet-help-signs/) , and general care advice.


### Dutch


Dutch offers scheduled and same-day virtual vet visits, follow-up messaging, and direct-to-door prescription delivery for over 150 conditions, including[allergies](https://petcube.com/blog/dog-itching/) ,[anxiety](https://petcube.com/blog/dog-separation-anxiety/) , and[fleas](https://petcube.com/blog/cat-fleas/) and ticks.


## Free vs Paid: What Does an Online Vet Cost?


“There are a few online vet services around, but the prices can jump once you start booking follow-ups,” notes a[Reddit user](https://www.reddit.com/r/CatAdvice/comments/1fu7y9a/best_and_most_affordable_online_vet/?ref=petcube.com) . It’s important to understand the costs before downloading an app or subscribing to an online service.


### Petcube App


You can download and use the basic features of the Petcube App for free. Extras and hardware options require separate fees and paid subscriptions.


### Dutch


The Dutch app is free to download, but using its telehealth services requires a paid membership of $12/month (billed $149 annually or in installments).


## Is It Legit? Reviews & Real Pet Parent Feedback


“Learn the ins and outs of veterinary telemedicine by learning about current providers who have already established a foothold in the marketplace,” advises Sarah Wallace, DVM, in a[Galaxy Vets](https://galaxyvets.com/learning-center/veterinary-telemedicine/?ref=petcube.com) article. Not all apps and services are legit.


### Petcube App


As the official companion app from Petcube, Inc. (a trusted smart pet hardware and care company), the Petcube App is legitimate. It averages 3.7 out of 5 stars on the US Apple App Store. Pet parents appreciate the basic[monitoring features](https://petcube.com/care/?ref=petcube.com) and criticize its navigation and prompts.


### Dutch


Dutch is a legitimate US-based subscription telehealth platform founded in 2021. It has mixed customer reviews on Trustpilot and Reddit, with subscription billing issues and shipping delays noted as negatives.


## Conclusion


The Petcube App is an all-in-one system that combines AI guidance, pet journals, and vet chat. Dutch is a veterinary telemedicine service specializing in virtual vet visits, treatment plans, and prescription deliveries.


[Download the Petcube App](https://petcube.com/mobile-app/?ref=petcube.com) and try it first-hand. Unlike Dutch, which requires a paid membership as of November 2026, the Petcube App is free, with paid tiers and add-ons only for extended features.
